# Company
> Gal Advisors is a boutique consulting firm specialising in cross-border payments, international banking solutions, payment processing, alternative payment methods (APM), and crypto integration advisory. The firm helps businesses worldwide access banking infrastructure across 30+ countries.

## Contact
- Email: mor@gal-advisors.com
- Website: https://www.gal-advisors.com

## Services

### Banking Solutions
Gal Advisors provides B2B, C2B, and B2C banking solutions including brick-and-mortar banks and white-label banking services across global markets.

### Payment Processing
Credit and debit card processing across EU, LATAM, Africa, SEA, EMEA, and the US — tailored for each business model.

### APM – Alternative Payment Methods
Open banking, mobile payments, e-wallets, and instant bank transfers. APM solutions for every market and customer segment worldwide.

### Cross-Border Payments
Seamless international payment solutions enabling businesses to send and receive funds across borders efficiently and compliantly, with multi-currency support.

### Crypto Solutions
Business crypto account setup, buy/sell/transfer infrastructure, and full crypto integration advisory for companies wanting to operate with cryptocurrency.

## Industries Served

## Why Choose Gal Advisors
- **Global Network**: Direct relationships with financial institutions across 30+ countries and multiple regulatory jurisdictions.
- **Rapid Execution**: Onboarding timelines reduced from months to weeks.
- **Dedicated Advisory**: A personal advisor assigned to every client account.
- **End-to-End Support**: From initial consultation through account opening and ongoing operational optimisation.
